senses.definition: demonstr.pron.pl. these (Nab. אלה (Lzb 264 Cooke 241), Cappad. and Egyptian Aramaic אלה (LzbEph. i. 323 RÉS 361 A 3 S-CPap. E 13, K 13): prob. therefore not, as used to be supposed, a Hebraism, but a peculiarity of the dialects of Je 10:11 and of Ezr (in which the usually Aramaic form אִלֵּין does not occur): v. further אִלֵּין);—these, Je 10:11 Ezr 5:15 Kt.
